purpose: Audit high-priority aggregate candidates before fitting. Distinguish genuine local-food capacity evidence from demographic floors, imported-food populations, administrative counts and unresolved boundaries.

disposition_summary.reason: Official 1327 population estimates, 1298 land-management cap and independent rangeland/ecology studies support a local-support floor. The 2020 food-balance source documents approximately 25% imported grain, so the old 90% local-food floor is replaced by a conservative 70-90% interval and no upper endpoint is created.
disposition_summary.mapping: 1 EU5 location (Torshavn), declared coverage 0.986, high crosswalk

disposition_summary.reason: Campbell county values are conditional on a 4.0 million national assumption and share the England source family; no county-specific upper capacity or saturation interval is independent of the national scale anchor.
disposition_summary.mapping: Existing province selectors have high geometry matches but are not formal historic county boundary proofs

disposition_summary.reason: Al-Nabulusi supplies local irrigation/tax fields and Rapoport supplies an approximately 75,000 fiscal reconstruction, but no closed rural boundary, total population interval, local-food share or saturation endpoint; Cairo/iqta redistribution is unresolved.
Great Land Registers establish rice-acreage floors but omit non-rice fields, population totals and upper saturation. No new aggregate target is created.
disposition_summary.mapping: Recheck aggregate intentionally unmapped; existing province-specific crosswalks remain separate

disposition_summary.reason: The 2.4337 million Yuan register is an administrative point in a canal and market redistribution system; no rural six-county crosswalk, local-food share or saturation endpoint is available.
Raised fields and wetland intensification are strong physical evidence, but basin/polity boundaries, political shocks and date-matched population/saturation intervals are unresolved.

Green/Kirch/Burley provide an explicit 18,000-24,000 capacity envelope and pressure evidence, but the closure audit finds a 0.52 area match, shared model family and chronology conflict with 50,000-60,000 LiDAR estimates.
disposition_summary.mapping: 1 EU5 location, 499.65 km2 versus 260 km2 source boundary, declared coverage 0.52; no rescaling

quality_gate.policy_result: Training can proceed with the corrected Faroe lower bound and existing vetted aggregate anchors; no weak two-sided candidate is admitted merely to increase geographic quota.
